title: The storm
_note: opens before the first journal line; the opening journal text (game.json start.log) follows when it ends

start.text:
You were three days out when the storm came. All evening the wind rose, and by midnight the boat was climbing black waves and falling into the troughs between them.

Then, in the dark, a crack like a gunshot. The hull has struck rock. Water roars in below deck and the ship lurches, already lower in the sea.

There is a moment, no more, to grab one thing before you jump.

swim_knife.text:
You jump with the knife clenched in your fist. The cold punches the breath out of you. A wave throws you under, then another, and each time you claw back to the surface, still gripping the blade.

You swim until your arms stop answering. Then sand scrapes your knees. You crawl out of the surf and lie still, the knife in your hand.

swim_matches.text:
You stuff the tin of matches inside your shirt and jump. The sea is black and freezing. Waves roll you over and over until you lose which way is up.

A swell lifts you and drops you on something hard: sand. You drag yourself above the tide line and press a hand to your chest. The tin is still there, still shut.

swim_water.text:
You grab the full water can and jump. It drags at you, heavy, but it floats a little, and you hold on to it like a raft while the waves break over your head.

At last your feet touch bottom. You stagger out of the surf with the can in your arms and fall onto the sand.

swim_rations.text:
You snatch the bag of rations and jump. The cold closes like a fist. A wave tears at the bag, so you wrap the strap around your wrist and kick, and kick.

The shore comes out of the dark all at once. You crawl onto the sand, the sodden bag still tied to your arm. Food for three days, if you are careful.
